# Repository instructions

Read and follow `AGENTS.md`, the canonical working agreement for this repository.
For security, billing, lifecycle or release changes, follow `docs/ENGINEERING_RULES.md`.
Before UI changes, follow `docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md`; if absent, derive it from the existing native
theme and components before adding controls, as required by `AGENTS.md`.
Inspect generated dependencies and lockfiles deliberately rather than adding them to general context.
